date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: R8-AS-001-FU1: September 19 reporting confirms renewed closure after an intermediate opening. Exact reclosure onset and uninterrupted enforcement are unknown. A September 27 report states that Rishtan–Kaytpas resumed passage for Kyrgyz and Uzbek citizens from September 25, 2017, between 07:00 and 19:00. This is a qualified later-access bound for that citizen cohort, not an exact first-traveller observation or a continuous September 19–25 closure duration. Apkan remained closed; the complete Sokh–Rishtan route, freight and third-country eligibility are not established. Do not carry the 2013 closure uninterrupted to 2017.
